name: Report Viewer

variants.label: Report Viewer
variants.tooltip: Enables reports to be embedded from the Reporting Module into a Perspective views.

schema.title: Report Viewer
schema.description: A component that displays a PDF version of a report.

source.title: Report Source
source.description: The path to the report being displayed.

params.title: Report Params
params.description: Any params that were created to accompany the report.

pageCount.title: Page Count
pageCount.description: The number of pages the pdf contains (read-only).

zoomLevel.description: The desired zoom level of the report based off of a percentage of the report width.

allowDownload.description: Allow a "download" icon to be displayed that will trigger a download of the report when clicked. This prop is always treated as false in Perspective iOS and Android apps.

downloadFilename.description: A filename used for the report when downloaded. Filename will default to the name of the report if not used.

allowOpenInTab.description: Allow an "open in tab" icon to be displayed that will open the report in a new browser tab when clicked. This prop is always treated as false in Perspective Workstation, iOS, and Android apps.

controlStyle.description: Style to apply to the control bar of the component.
